trigger.description: Create a service that handles the blob events an Event Grid subscription delivers to an Azure Storage queue.

metadata.label: Queue Name
metadata.description: The storage queue the service's Event Grid subscription delivers blob events to

metadata.label: Poison Queue Name
metadata.description: The queue failed messages move to; defaults to the queue name with '-poison' appended

metadata.label: Batch Size
metadata.description: How many messages one receive fetches, 1 to 32 (default 16)

metadata.label: New Batch Threshold
metadata.description: Fetch the next batch when this many events are still being handled; 0 to the batch size, default half of it

metadata.label: Maximum Polling Interval (seconds)
metadata.description: The longest wait between polls of an empty queue (default 60)

metadata.label: Redelivery Delay (seconds)
metadata.description: How long a message stays invisible after its handler fails before it is redelivered, 0 to 604800 (default 0)

metadata.label: Maximum Delivery Count
metadata.description: How many deliveries a message gets before it is moved to the poison queue, at least 1 (default 5)
